title: Auditing the Planning Decoder of a Reference End-to-End Driving Stack: code and results
description:
Code and results accompanying the paper. Contains the one-line correction for the occupancy coordinate-truncation defect in UniAD's planning decoder, three magnitude-matched controls (mirror, uniform-random direction, allocation permutation), the analysis scripts, per-arm configurations, and the result files behind every number reported in the paper.

All experiments use the public uniad_base_e2e checkpoint on the full nuScenes validation split (6,019 frames) with no retraining. UniAD and nuScenes are not redistributed and remain under their own licences.
